tools.name: get_plans_and_pricing
tools.description: Returns Virtual Assistant Capital's published virtual assistant plans, monthly prices in US dollars, hours and standard terms.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the industries and roles Virtual Assistant Capital places virtual assistants for, each with a page URL. An optional query filters by keyword, for example 'dental' or 'bookkeeping'.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Returns the tasks a Virtual Assistant Capital assistant handles for one industry or role, with the page URL. Accepts a name or keyword such as 'real estate', 'insurance agency' or 'virtual receptionist'.

tools.name: get_hiring_process
tools.description: Returns how hiring through Virtual Assistant Capital works: the steps, timelines, standard terms, service limits and where to send a request.

tools.name: compare_cost_with_local_hire
tools.description: Calculates the monthly cost of a local hire from an hourly wage, weekly hours and an optional employer on-cost percentage, and shows it beside the Virtual Assistant Capital plan with the closest hours. Uses only the numbers supplied; treats the wage as US dollars.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches Virtual Assistant Capital's published guides about hiring, onboarding, managing and pricing virtual assistants, and returns matching titles, summaries and URLs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, get_service_details, search_guides · Public sink: get_hiring_process.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, get_service_details, search_guides · Public sink: get_hiring_process

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
